from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689854/attempts/71aa0823e1d7415ab0ea5a5c0e56a9c6/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    """Fill each hollow rectangular outline by interior-area parity."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                rr, cc = q.popleft()
                cells.append((rr, cc))
                for nr, nc in ((rr-1,cc),(rr+1,cc),(rr,cc-1),(rr,cc+1)):
                    if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and (nr,nc) not in seen and grid[nr][nc] != bg:
                        seen.add((nr,nc))
                        q.append((nr,nc))
            r0 = min(x for x,y in cells); r1 = max(x for x,y in cells)
            c0 = min(y for x,y in cells); c1 = max(y for x,y in cells)
            # A frame must be a complete, single-color rectangular perimeter.
            if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
                continue
            perimeter = {(rr,cc) for rr in range(r0,r1+1) for cc in range(c0,c1+1)
                         if rr in (r0,r1) or cc in (c0,c1)}
            if all(grid[rr][cc] == color for rr,cc in perimeter) and set(cells) == perimeter:
                fill = 2 if ((r1-r0-1)*(c1-c0-1)) % 2 == 0 else 7
                for rr in range(r0+1,r1):
                    for cc in range(c0+1,c1):
                        out[rr][cc] = fill
    return out
'''
